title: Eastern Noodle Bowl
description: A hearty and comforting noodle bowl filled with the flavors of the East. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Middle Eastern Noodles
ingredients.notes: or substitute with rice or quinoa

instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the falafel and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Add the wilted greens to the skillet and cook until wilted.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
To assemble the noodle bowls, place a scoop of noodles on a plate, followed by a scoop of falafel and greens.
Top with chopped cucumber and red onion, if using.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately.
